name: Jobcards Online Integration
author: jobcardsonline

sections.description:
Provides integration between https://www.jobcardsonline.co.za and the woocommerce wordpress plugin. This plugin allows invoices, pro-forma invoices and clients to be created on jobcardsonline inside of wordpress. It provides integration of the jobcardsonline system for use with woocommerce.

Woocommerce products can by synced from inventory in Jobcards Online. Can sync manually or automated via cronjob.
sections.installation:
1. Upload folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Get your API Access codes from jobcardsonline.co.za -> Settings -> API Access and enter them into the Jobcards Online Settings screen.
  4. Save and you’re ready to go.
